earnings_release.text: EX-99 2 exhibit99-q32026earningsre.htm EX-99 Document Exhibit 99 Contacts: Media Investor Relations Stacey Jones Mark Macaluso (980) 378-6258 (704) 627-6118 stacey.jones@honeywell.com mark.macaluso@honeywell.com HONEYWELL TECHNOLOGIES REPORTS THIRD QUARTER RESULTS, RAISES FULL-YEAR 2026 OUTLOOK • Sales of $5.0 billion, up 1% reported (7% organic 1 ) driven by broad-based growth across all segments • Operating margin of 14.8%, up 640 basis points; segment margin 1 of 21.3%, up 370 basis points • Earnings per share (EPS) of $2.40, down 20% due to one-time gain in prior year; adjusted EPS 1 of $2.27, up 34% • Operating cash of $0.6 billion; free cash flow 1 of $0.7 billion, with conversion 1 of 95% • Raising full-year organic revenue, adjusted EPS and free cash flow guidance; expect segment margin to be at previous high end of guidance CHARLOTTE, N.C., October 22, 2026 -- Honeywell Technologies (NASDAQ: HON) today announced financial results for the third quarter of 2026. The company reported third-quarter sales of $5.0 billion, up 1% reported and 7% organic 1 , driven by broad-based strength across all three segments, pricing actions, and continued demand across key end markets. Backlog increased 7% year over year to nearly $19 billion, excluding Warehouse and Workflow Solutions (WWS) and Productivity Solutions and Services (PSS) divestitures in 3Q 2026. Operating income increased 79% and segment profit 1 increased 23% driven by productivity, including elimination of stranded costs related to prior spin-offs and divestitures, pricing actions that more than offset inflation, and volume leverage. Operating margin of 14.8% increased 640 basis points and segment margin 1 of 21.3% expanded 370 basis points, led by Industrial Automation and Building Automation. Reported EPS decreased 20% primarily due to a one-time gain from the Resideo termination agreement in prior year. Excluding the impact of this and other items, adjusted earnings per share 1 increased 34% year over year to $2.27 driven by organic sales growth, higher segment profit, and lower net interest expense. Finally, operating cash flow of $607 million decreased 74% primarily due to the one-time settlement from the Resideo termination agreement in prior year, while free cash flow 1 of $688 million increased 15%, with free cash flow conversion 1 of 95%, driven by higher operating income and lower capital expenditures. - MORE - Honeywell Technologies Q3’26 Results - 2 Management Commentary “Honeywell Technologies delivered strong results across the business in our first quarter as a standalone company. Continued momentum across all three segments, together with our improving position in high-growth verticals, translated to 7% organic sales growth, above the three-year target set at our June Investor Day. This performance, coupled with continued progress reducing fixed cost, enabled adjusted operating income to increase at more than three times the rate of sales, while adjusted EPS rose 34%, well ahead of our expectations for the quarter. As a result of this strong performance, we are raising our full-year 2026 outlook, which gives me great confidence in our long-term strategy and our ability to deliver on our 2029 targets,” said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Vimal Kapur. Table 1: Summary of Financial Results (Dollars in millions, except per share amounts) 3Q 2026 3Q 2025 Change Sales $4,994 $4,929 1% Organic 1 Growth 7% Operating Income $740 $413 79% Operating Income Margin 14.8% 8.4% 640 bps Segment Profit 1 $1,062 $866 23% Segment Margin 1 21.3% 17.6% 370 bps Earnings Per Share - Continuing Operations $2.40 $2.99 (20%) Adjusted Earnings Per Share 1 $2.27 $1.70 34% Cash Flow from Operations - Continuing Operations $607 $2,306 (74%) Free Cash Flow 1,4 $688 $599 15% Table 2: Summary of Segment Financial Results (Dollars in millions) BUILDING AUTOMATION 3Q 2026 3Q 2025 Change Sales $2,020 $1,878 8% Organic 1 Growth 8% Segment Profit $546 $502 9% Segment Margin 27.0% 26.7% 30 bps PROCESS AUTOMATION AND TECHNOLOGY Sales $1,859 $1,598 16% Organic 1 Growth 8% Segment Profit $412 $389 6% Segment Margin 22.2% 24.3% (210) bps INDUSTRIAL AUTOMATION Sales $1,115 $1,450 (23%) Organic 1 Growth 4% Segment Profit $205 $216 (5%) Segment Margin 18.4% 14.9% 350 bps - MORE - Honeywell Technologies Q3’26 Results - 3 Building Automation sales grew 8% organically 1 year over year. Building products grew 11%, fueled by the fire and security businesses, while building solutions grew 4% on continued strength in services. Segment margin expanded 30 basis points to 27.0%, benefiting from volume leverage and pricing actions that offset inflation. Process Automation and Technology sales increased 8% organically 1 year over year. Project sales grew 14% led by continued growth in LNG and petrochemical projects, while aftermarket grew 4% driven primarily by refining demand. Margins contracted 210 basis points as expected driven by project mix and dilution from the acquisition of Johnson Matthey’s Catalyst Technologies business. Industrial Automation sales grew 4% organically 1 year over year led by 16% growth in solutions, driven primarily by industrial measurement and utilities. Products were flat year over year with double-digit growth in sensing largely offset by industry-wide meter deployment deferrals in utilities. Segment margin expanded 350 basis points year over year to 18.4%, driven primarily by price and productivity actions, partially offset by inflation. Table 3: Full-Year 2026 Guidance 1 Previous Guidance Current Guidance Sales $19.8B - $20.0B $20.0B - $20.1B Organic Growth 3% - 4% 4% - 5% Segment Margin 2 20.1% - 20.5% ~20.5% Expansion Up 250 - 290 bps Up ~290 bps Adjusted Earnings Per Share 2,3 $8.05 - $8.35 $8.40 - $8.45 Adjusted Earnings Growth 3 25% - 29% 30% - 31% Operating Cash Flow ~$2.1B ~$2.1B Free Cash Flow 4 ~$2.0B ~$2.1B 1 See additional information at the end of this release regarding non-GAAP financial measures. 2 Segment margin and adjusted EPS are non-GAAP financial measures. Management cannot reliably predict or estimate, without unreasonable effort, the impact and timing on future operating results arising from items excluded from segment margin and adjusted EPS. We therefore, do not present a guidance range, or a reconciliation to, the nearest GAAP financial measures of operating margin or EPS. 3 Adjusted EPS and adjusted EPS V% guidance excludes items identified in the non-GAAP reconciliation of adjusted EPS at the end of this release, and any potential future one-time items that we cannot reliably predict or estimate. 4 With respect to historical periods, free cash flow adjusts for capital expenditures, separation-related cost payments, Resideo indemnification and reimbursement agreement termination payment, cash payment for settlement of the divestiture of asbestos liabilities, and cash flows attributable to Quantinuum. With respect to the company’s outlook for 2026, free cash flow adjusts for capital expenditures, separation-related cost payments, and cash flows attributable to Quantinuum. Revised 2026 Guidance Honeywell Technologies is raising its full-year outlook for organic revenue, adjusted EPS and free cash flow, and also now expects segment margin to be at the previous high end of guidance, following strong third quarter performance and continued momentum across the portfolio. The company now expects full-year sales of $20.0 billion to $20.1 billion with organic 1 sales growth of 4% to 5%, and 5% to 6% organic 1 growth in the fourth quarter; segment margin 1 of approximately 20.5%, at the upper end of its previous guidance range, representing segment margin 1 expansion of approximately 290 basis points; and adjusted earnings per share 1 of $8.40 to $8.45, up 30% to 31%, representing a $0.23 increase from the midpoint of its previous guidance range. Finally, operating cash flow and free cash flow are now expected to be ~$2.1 billion each. - MORE - Honeywell Technologies Q3’26 Results - 4 Conference Call Details Honeywell Technologies will discuss its third-quarter results and full-year 2026 guidance for during an investor conference call starting at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Daylight Time today. A live webcast of the investor call as well as related presentation materials will be available through the Investor Relations section of the company's website ( www.honeywell.com/investor ). A replay of the webcast will be available for 30 days following the presentation. About Honeywell Technologies Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy. For more news and information on Honeywell Technologies, please visit Honeywell Technologies Newsroom. reference.summary: Honeywell International Inc. engages in the industrial automation, building automation, and energy and sustainability solutions businesses in the United States, Europe, and internationally. The Industrial Automation segment provides automation control and instrumentation products and services; smart energy products; sensing technologies, including custom-engineered sensors and related services; gas detection technologies and personal protective equipment; and system design automation equipment, as well as software and analytics for manufacturing, distribution, and fulfillment operations. The Building Automation segment provides software applications for building control and optimization; sensors, switches, control systems, and instruments for energy management; access control; video surveillance; fire products; and installation, maintenance, and system upgrade services.
